method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied (the worker), with a second seat layer for the person conducting the business or undertaking, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE (work under a State or Territory WHS law answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Work Health and Safety Act 2011, Compilation No. 16, compilation date 1 July 2024 (register id C2024C00243, retrieved 2026-10-13), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2011A00137.txt. No instrument brought in: the Work Health and Safety Regulations 2011 are not deposited; Schedule 4 penalties are the printed figures before indexation (the cl 4 formula was lost in conversion).

scope: Worker seat: ss 5(7)-(8), 7(1), (2A) (worker), 12(1)-(2), (4), (6), 12A (application), 17, 19 (duties owed), 47-49 (consultation), 50 (HSR election), 80(1), 81(2), 82 (unresolved issues), 84-86, 88 (ceasing unsafe work; s 85 direction as an input), 28 (worker duties), 30A-34 and Schedule 4 cl 1 (penalties before indexation), 35-37 (notifiable incidents), 105, 106, 112, 113, 115(a) (discrimination for raising safety). PCBU seat: ss 38(1)-(4), (7), 39, 47-49, 87, 30A-33 with Schedule 4. Out: ss 20-27, 29, 46, Part 4, Part 5 Div 3 beyond s 50, Divs 4 and 7, Part 6 Div 2, Part 7, Parts 8-14, Schedule 4 cls 3-5, Schedules 1-3; State and Territory WHS laws (not covered).
